thread:
Samir: kicking off LGA1 commissioning dry-run now. goal: validate GPU quota, control-plane egress, and per-tenant SLOs. timeline ~2h. volunteers? :spiral_calendar:
Rita: I can take GPU quota + prov scripts. what's the terraform workspace name?
Samir: use `tf workspace select lga1-commission` then `terraform apply -var-file=lga1.vars.json` — run in ci-provisioner host.
Kai: will run net pathing and PSN QoS tests. posting traceroute and iperf shortly.
Rita: started quota check: API returns 24/32 GPUs available. tagging @Emily for commit vs burst decision.
Emily: noted. for cost gate we need to cap burst to 8 GPUs until billing window. set `max_burst: 8` in cluster config.
Samir: added patch to config repo, PR 3489. can someone approve so we don't hit cost spike?
Ops-bot: provision-checker: control-plane healthy, etcd 3/3, kube-api latency p50=22ms p99=120ms.
Kai: traceroute to worker-01 shows no asymmetric hop. iperf3 baseline: 9.8 Gbps between zones.
Rita: booted 3 GPU nodes, nvtop shows all cards present. quick smoke with resnet: 1.8ms per token (local bench).
Samir: running autoscaler smoke: set min=2 max=20, simulated load. scale events observed and no 429s.
Emily: approved cost cap PR 3489, added note to billing team. :white_check_mark:
Samir: next steps: handoff docs -> /runbooks/regions/lga1-commissioning.md, schedule 15m sync with oncall. any blockers?
Kai: none from networking. leaving small postmortem checklist in thread.
Rita: one minor: firewall rule 1024 had wrong CIDR, fixed.
Samir: great. tagging this thread for post-run notes and final signoff. thanks all.
